description: Rio于1924年推出的折叠相机。配备Orionwerk Spezial-Aplanat 7.5cm f/8, apertures down to f/32。快门速度Pronto leaf-shutter T-B-25-50-100 1/s。

specs.镜头: Orionwerk Spezial-Aplanat 7.5cm f/8, apertures down to f/32
specs.英文简介: The Rio 84 A is a strut-folding camera taking 4×6.5cm pictures on 127 film, made by Orionwerk in Hannover, Germany in about 1924.
